description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Shipwreck Dowser
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
